variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman sends the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him to drive Red Corwin out of the watchtower on Crow Hill.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Help! Help! We're being robbed! Hurry to the Moot Hall and see Halvard!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Damn! What kept you, lad!? Red Corwin's bandits stormed the old watchtower and they'd have had the whole north road too if I hadn't shut the gate on them at the very last moment!

But with the gate shut, no cart or trader can get down from the north, leaving the wolves and the Urchins the least of our troubles! All Brackenford will go hungry if the road stays closed!

You must go where the bandits are holed up, north to the watchtower on Crow Hill! Throw Corwin out or we are ruined!

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: I'm sure Corwin grows bolder by the hour! Go quickly!

journal.text: Go to Crow Hill and drive out Red Corwin.

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Ulmar sets the player down off his airship above Ostrum and sends him to his old friend Foreman Dagrim, while Grummox's Ogres hold the deep.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Help! The Ogres are in the lower shafts! Somebody fetch Foreman Dagrim!

opening.speaker: Ulmar
opening.text:
I'll set you down here, lad. Grummox's Ogres keep too close a watch on the mountain to fly any nearer.

Take the mine road down to Ostrum.

Seek out my old friend Dagrim, the Foreman. He'll lend you a hand if he can.

And take these potions. Should the Ogres corner you, they'll keep you on your feet. Mind how you go, lad.

reminder.speaker: Ulmar
reminder.text: Go on! Don't dawdle here. Down the road with you.

journal.text: Find Foreman Dagrim's house in the Village of Ostrum.

variants.specifics: Vell: Ulmar brings the player to Vell and sends him to Mayor Pellig and on against Grulga's Sunken Keep.

herald.speaker: Tansy
herald.text: My, my! You're a lot nicer to look at than the usual fellows Ulmar drags in! Come and see me once Mayor Pellig is done with you.

opening.speaker: Ulmar
opening.text:
Here we are, lad. Vell -- last stronghold of the free folk of the Black Fen! Home of the stout-hearted Marsh Guard!

Get yourself into Vell, find Mayor Pellig and then be ready for the fight of your life -- Grulga's Sunken Keep. Only the bravest come back out.

journal.text: Find a way into the Village of Vell.

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Yorra points the player to Baron Hadrim in the keep; the Baron sends him east to Commander Rusk at the Grael Gorge outpost, where Vargoth's Ogres hold the old fort.

herald.speaker: Yorra
herald.text: I'm late for market, sorry. Baron Hadrim is up in the keep.

opening.speaker: Hadrim
opening.text:
Something is very wrong in our valley. I need you to ride east to Grael Gorge. There you must find Commander Rusk at the outpost.

He has asked for our help against the Ogres of the sorcerer Vargoth, who now hold the old fort above the pass.

Take these potions -- and gold. Visit Brokk's forge for anything more. Then hurry.

The road through the east gate will lead you to the Gorge.

reminder.speaker: Hadrim
reminder.text: There is nothing more I can tell you, brave Adventurer. Ride now, and help Commander Rusk hold the Gorge!

journal.text: Leave Tarnhold and find Commander Rusk at the Grael Gorge outpost.

variants.specifics: Tolvin: A townsman points the player to Mayor Gorvane in the Town Hall, who sends him to take back the Orb of Calling from Black Varrick's rogues on Heron Rock.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Those rogues on Heron Rock are a filthy and thieving band of cutthroats! If you mean to fight them, see Mayor Gorvane in the Town Hall!

opening.speaker: Mayor Gorvane
opening.text:
So Master Quillan sent you! The road to Tolvin has tested your mettle, I'm sure, lad. But this is no time to put your feet up. You must now take back the Orb of Calling, which Black Varrick's rogues stole from this very hall when they raided our poor village!

With the rogues on the move and the Orb as their prize, I'm certain Varrick is behind the Urchin raids too. They hold the old watchtower on Heron Rock and the north road is shut. I'll send word to Tobb at the north gate to let you through. Now, off with you!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Gorvane
reminder.text: Hurry to the north gate! Tobb will let you through.

journal.text: Recover the Orb of Calling from Black Varrick's rogues.

variants.specifics: Olvane: Haskel brings the player to Olvane and sends him up to Provost Tibald at the College, while Grelvin's Undead hold the Observatory.

opening.speaker: Haskel
opening.text:
Here we are, lad -- Olvane. I can take you no farther than this.

Up these steps you'll find the College, and Provost Tibald, an old friend of mine. He knows you're coming. I must be off, and you'd best hurry too!

Only you can stop Grelvin now.

journal.text: Find Provost Tibald, Haskel's old friend, at the College.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Fenna points the player to Brannoc, Warden of Fort Ostkar, who sends him to the Signal Tower against Kragan.

herald.speaker: Fenna
herald.text: Aiiieee! Trolls! Trolls! Run to Brannoc!

opening.speaker: Brannoc
opening.text:
Greetings. I am Brannoc. The Warden of Fort Ostkar. Thrane writes that you are the one to break Kragan's hold on the pass. The warlock sits behind the Upper Gate, guarded by his brutish Trolls.

You must climb to the Signal Tower and speak to the lookouts. Take this key. It opens the postern door that leads up to the tower.

reminder.speaker: Brannoc
reminder.text:
Kragan must be driven out! YOU are the one Thrane trusts to open this pass.

Go now! The snows will not wait.

journal.text: Speak to the lookouts in the Signal Tower.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Dibble points the player to Mayor Dunbrak, whose Forge Hammer the Imps carried off into the Cinder Caves.

herald.speaker: Dibble
herald.text: Not now. Go see Mayor Dunbrak.

opening.speaker: Mayor Dunbrak
opening.text:
Welcome to Orvak, valiant Adventurer! Wendril told us you'd be coming!

The Imps who live in the Cinder Caves have gone crazy! They swarmed into town and made off with my Forge Hammer! A smith chased the little devils back into the caves, but he never came back.

Go into the Cinder Caves north of town and take my hammer back from the Imps. When you return, come and see me. I'll be in my house next to the Great Forge.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Dunbrak
reminder.text: Those wretched Imps are making a terrible mess of things lately.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Dunbrak's Forge Hammer from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: A townsman sends the player, Oberik's man, to Ambrin at the old drain, who sends him into Fort Ulm for the north gate key Chief Urgoth keeps.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: WHAT? Oberik sent... YOU? Well, Ambrin's waiting for you by the old drain.

opening.speaker: Ambrin
opening.text:
Sorry about the muck, lad, but the old drain is the only way into Fort Ulm without a fight. There are two Ogres on guard here and plenty more inside.

You must bring back the north gate key, but Chief Urgoth won't part with it easily. This could get very nasty, lad. But these potions will help.

reminder.speaker: Ambrin
reminder.text: The Invisibility potion will help you slip past the Ogres. The Haste potion will keep anyone from catching you as you run back out. Good luck and be swift.

journal.text: Sneak into Fort Ulm through the old drain.

variants.specifics: Corvale: Hettie points the player to Master Ebbrin, who sends him to the Ogre-held watchtower on Thistle Hill for the Horn of Corvale and the North Gate key.

herald.speaker: Hettie
herald.text: Hello, stranger. Has Master Ebbrin found you, yet?

opening.speaker: Master Ebbrin
opening.text:
You're here. Good. Captain Brannoc chose well. Your first task is a very important one.

Something foul is stirring in the valley. Ogre raids on the outlying farms is growing worse with every week.

My attempts to send for help have come to nothing. The Ogres stop every rider on the north road. Perhaps you can help me there.

The old watchtower on Thistle Hill has not been manned in many years, and now the Ogres hold it. The old town records say the tower keeps two things which might be vital to our defense. One is the Horn of Corvale, the other is the key to the North Gate.

If you can bring these things back to me, quickly, I believe they will help us drive the Ogres from our fields.

reminder.speaker: Master Ebbrin
reminder.text: Nothing yet? Well, keep searching the old watchtower. The horn and the key must be found at once!

journal.text: Retrieve the Horn of Corvale for Master Ebbrin.
